page.overview:
Who is Gelarna?

She is guarding Leane Sharif when Egwene al'Vere comes to visit her in the cells. A Bubble of evil erupts and begins to melt Leane's cell. Leane is saved when Gelarna and Musarin pull her out of the cell with weaves of Air.
